name: avodah
description: Work management built on shefa economic primitives. The conversation between lamad (wisdom) and avodah (action) is where value in shefa is created.

work-story.description: A work item in a project. Category C (operational, stored in projection only). Task completion produces economic events in shefa. Attestation gates reference lamad content that must be mastered before the task can be started.

work-project.description: A container for work stories with board configuration and team membership. Category C (operational). Project milestones produce economic events.

BELONGS_TO.description: Work story belongs to a project.

DEPENDS_ON.description: Work story depends on another work story for completion.

REQUIRES.description: Work story requires mastery of lamad content (attestation gate).

task-completed.description: Emitted when a work story transitions to done. Produces an economic event in shefa recording the work output.

sprint-completed.description: Emitted when all stories in a sprint/cadence are completed. Produces a milestone economic event.

cadence-reset.description: Emitted when a cadence cycle resets — incomplete stories move according to resetBehavior.

delivery-health.description: Tasks are completing on cadence with declared value delivered

delivery-divergence.description: Tasks are not completing on cadence or delivered value diverges from declared intent

cadence-sustainability.description: Work pace is sustainable — no burnout signals, consistent throughput

cadence-burnout.description: Work pace is unsustainable — overruns accumulating, team capacity declining

task-completion-rate.description: Tasks completing at expected rate relative to capacity

cadence-overrun.description: Tasks consistently exceeding their cadence — planning or scoping problem
